questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): PM eVIDYA relies heavily on digital broadcasting.
Reason (R): Broadcasting educational content via television and radio completely replaces the need for local school teachers.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is correct: The PM eVIDYA initiative, launched under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan in May 2020, is a comprehensive multi-modal educational access program. A cornerstone of PM eVIDYA is digital broadcasting via the 'One Class, One TV Channel' scheme (expanding to 200 SWAYAM PRABHA DTH channels), alongside extensive use of All India Radio, community radio, and podcasts to deliver curriculum-aligned education even in remote areas without internet access.
Reason (R) is false: Educational broadcasting serves as a supplementary and enriching instructional tool; it can never replace the classroom teacher. The pedagogical role of a teacher encompasses diagnostic assessment, socio-emotional scaffolding, individualized remediation, motivational mentorship, and facilitating interactive peer dialogue—functions that broadcast media inherently cannot perform.
Therefore, Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false. Hence, Option C is correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है: मई 2020 में आत्मनिर्भर भारत अभियान के अंतर्गत शुरू की गई 'पीएम ई-विद्या' (PM eVIDYA) पहल एक व्यापक मल्टी-मोड डिजिटल शिक्षा कार्यक्रम है। इसका एक प्रमुख स्तंभ उपग्रह आधारित डिजिटल प्रसारण है, जिसके अंतर्गत 'वन क्लास, वन टीवी चैनल' योजना (स्वयं प्रभा के माध्यम से 200 समर्पित डीटीएच टीवी चैनल), आकाशवाणी (AIR), कम्युनिटी रेडियो और पॉडकास्ट के जरिए देश के दूरदराज के क्षेत्रों तक पाठ्यक्रम-आधारित शैक्षणिक सामग्री प्रसारित की जाती है।
कारण (R) गलत है: प्रसारण तकनीक केवल एक पूरक और सहायक माध्यम है; यह कभी भी कक्षा के शिक्षक का स्थान नहीं ले सकती। शिक्षक का कार्य केवल सूचना देना नहीं, बल्कि छात्रों की व्यक्तिगत कठिनाइयों का निदान (Diagnosis), उपचारात्मक शिक्षण, भावनात्मक सहयोग, प्रेरणा तथा कक्षा में संवाद और सहयोगात्मक अधिगम का संचालन करना है, जो एकतरफा टीवी या रेडियो प्रसारण द्वारा संभव नहीं है।
अतः (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) गलत है। इसलिए विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: PM eVIDYA relies heavily on satellite broadcasting via television and radio to deliver educational programs nationally. Educational broadcasting enriches learning access but does not replace classroom teachers, whose instructional guidance, social support, and diagnostic assessment remain central to education.

questions.question_english: A school Principal aims to ensure the effective pedagogical integration of PM eVIDYA digital resources into daily classroom teaching. Which supervisory approach is the most pedagogically sound and effective?
options_english: Reviewing teacher lesson plans for technology integration and conducting focused classroom walk-throughs to observe real-time usage
Issuing a single administrative circular or mass email directing all staff members to deploy the digital resources
Informally querying students during morning assembly about whether they view educational television broadcasts at home
Assuming complete institutional compliance solely based on formal ministerial mandates and circulars
questions.explanation_english: Effective instructional leadership requires active, evidence-based supervisory methods rather than passive administrative compliance. Under the Government of India's PM eVIDYA initiative, comprehensive multi-modal educational resources (including 12 Swayam Prabha DTH TV channels for classes 1-12, DIKSHA platform, community radio, and special e-content for children with disabilities) are provided. To ensure these resources are purposefully blended into regular instruction, a school Principal must review teachers' lesson plans to examine curricular alignment and conduct routine classroom walk-throughs. Direct classroom observation allows the leader to evaluate how digital content is integrated into teacher-student interactions, assess student engagement, and provide meaningful pedagogical coaching. Generic emails or administrative assumptions fail to guarantee instructional fidelity.
questions.explanation_hindi: एक प्रभावी शैक्षणिक नेता (प्रधानाचार्य/प्राचार्य) के रूप में डिजिटल पहलों के वास्तविक क्रियान्वयन की निगरानी हेतु प्रत्यक्ष, रचनात्मक और साक्ष्य-आधारित पर्यवेक्षण आवश्यक होता है। भारत सरकार की 'पीएम ई-विद्या' (PM eVIDYA) पहल 'एक कक्षा, एक चैनल' (12 डीटीएच टीवी चैनल), दीक्षा (DIKSHA), ई-कंटेंट और रेडियो प्रसारणों के माध्यम से बहु-माध्यमीय शैक्षिक पहुंच सुनिश्चित करती है। इसके कक्षा-कक्ष स्तर पर प्रभावी एकीकरण को सुनिश्चित करने के लिए प्राचार्य को शिक्षकों की दैनिक पाठ-योजनाओं में प्रौद्योगिकी के समावेश का परीक्षण करना चाहिए और नियमित रूप से कक्षाओं का प्रत्यक्ष अवलोकन (classroom walk-throughs) करना चाहिए। इससे यह स्पष्ट होता है कि शिक्षक डिजिटल सामग्री का उपयोग केवल औपचारिकता के लिए तो नहीं कर रहे, बल्कि वह अधिगम प्रतिफलों (learning outcomes) की प्राप्ति में सक्रिय भूमिका निभा रही है। केवल ईमेल भेजने या स्वतः अनुपालन मान लेने से वास्तविक शैक्षणिक सुधार संभव नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Checking lesson plans and observing eVIDYA use during classroom walk-throughs

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Effective administrative supervision of digital initiative integration relies on direct pedagogical observation and curriculum review. School leaders verify technology utilization by checking teacher lesson plans and conducting classroom walkthroughs to observe how digital resources are integrated into active instruction.

questions.question_english: During a school inspection, the principal notes that the LCD projectors are frequently malfunctioning due to dust accumulation. What is the most appropriate administrative response?
options_english: Discard all digital projectors permanently and revert strictly to traditional chalk and talk methods
Deduct the full hardware repair cost directly from the monthly salaries of the teachers using them
Lock all malfunctioning projectors in the school store room indefinitely to prevent further damage
Establish a preventive maintenance contract for school ICT hardware
questions.explanation_english: Proactive and sustainable administrative leadership requires institutionalizing preventative maintenance systems for school educational technology infrastructure. LCD projectors contain cooling fans that suck in room air, leading to rapid dust accumulation on optical filters, prisms, and lamps if unmaintained. Establishing a formal Annual Preventive Maintenance Contract (AMC) ensures regular cleaning of air filters, alignment checks, thermal paste reapplication, and lamp servicing, protecting institutional capital investment and preventing instructional disruptions.
questions.explanation_hindi: कुशल शैक्षिक प्रशासन एवं संस्थागत प्रबंधन के अंतर्गत तकनीकी अवसंरचना की सुरक्षा और निरंतर कार्यशीलता सुनिश्चित करना एक प्रमुख प्रशासनिक दायित्व है। एलसीडी प्रोजेक्टरों में उच्च तापन को नियंत्रित करने के लिए पंखे लगे होते हैं, जिससे धूल जमने से उनके फिल्टर और लेंस अवरुद्ध हो जाते हैं। एक प्रधानाचार्य के रूप में सबसे उपयुक्त समाधान यह है कि आईसीटी उपकरणों के नियमित निरीक्षण, सफाई और सर्विसिंग के लिए एक व्यवस्थित 'निवारक रखरखाव अनुबंध' (Annual Maintenance Contract - AMC) स्थापित किया जाए। इससे उपकरणों की आयु बढ़ती है, पूँजी की सुरक्षा होती है और शिक्षण कार्य में कोई बाधा उत्पन्न नहीं होती।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Establish a preventive maintenance contract for school ICT hardware

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Administrative oversight requires proactive maintenance systems to ensure the operational longevity of technology infrastructure. Establishing formal preventive maintenance agreements ensures regular equipment servicing, filter cleaning, and technical support, protecting capital investments and minimizing classroom instructional disruptions caused by hardware malfunctions.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements best describes the pedagogical concept of "Blended Learning" in contemporary education?
options_english: Combining face-to-face classroom teaching with online digital instruction
Mechanically blending multiple distinct academic subjects into a single compiled printed textbook
Arbitrarily mixing students across widely disparate age groups into a single combined classroom space
Simultaneously using both traditional black and blue liquid inks on a standard classroom chalkboard
questions.explanation_english: Blended learning (also known as hybrid learning) is an instructional methodology that intentionally combines traditional face-to-face classroom teaching with online, digital educational activities and resources. In this pedagogical model, physical classroom time is optimized for collaborative activities, discussions, personalized teacher-student interactions, and higher-order cognitive tasks, while digital components provide students with flexibility, self-paced content engagement, multimedia resources, and continuous formative assessment. It leverages the strengths of both direct human instruction and digital technology, avoiding the extremes of purely virtual or purely traditional classrooms. The other options represent absurd or irrelevant interpretations.
questions.explanation_hindi: मिश्रित अधिगम (Blended Learning या संकर अधिगम) आधुनिक शिक्षाशास्त्र का एक ऐसा उपागम है, जिसमें प्रत्यक्ष आमने-सामने (face-to-face) के कक्षा-कक्ष शिक्षण को ऑनलाइन डिजिटल अधिगम अनुभवों के साथ सुनियोजित ढंग से एकीकृत किया जाता है। इस प्रतिमान में प्रत्यक्ष कक्षा अंतःक्रिया, शिक्षक के प्रत्यक्ष मार्गदर्शन तथा सहपाठियों के साथ सहयोगात्मक अधिगम का मेल कंप्यूटर/इंटरनेट आधारित स्वाध्यायी शिक्षण सामग्री, मल्टीमीडिया मॉड्यूल्स तथा डिजिटल मूल्यांकन से कराया जाता है। इससे शिक्षार्थियों को अपनी गति (self-pacing) से सीखने का अवसर मिलता है तथा कक्षा का समय उच्च स्तरीय संज्ञानात्मक कौशल और गहन विमर्श के लिए उपलब्ध रहता है। अन्य विकल्प असंगत एवं भ्रामक व्याख्याएँ हैं।

questions.explanation_english: The flipped classroom model inverts traditional pedagogical approaches by moving direct instruction (lectures, readings) outside the classroom via digital media and moving homework/active problem-solving inside the classroom under teacher guidance. It enables educators to upload curated multimedia, lecture recordings, quizzes, and background readings that students complete at their own pace prior to class. Consequently, valuable face-to-face classroom time is reserved for higher-order cognitive tasks, experiential activities, peer collaboration, and targeted formative feedback. questions.question_english: Which of the following is a key characteristic of effective ‘Flashcards’ when utilized as non-projected instructional aids?
options_english: Containing extensive, densely printed textual paragraphs to facilitate comprehensive reading
Being presented rapidly in brief intervals to promote mental automaticity and swift cognitive recall
Requiring mandatory optical projection onto a large interactive display screen
Serving exclusively as standardized instruments for formal high-stakes summative assessments
questions.explanation_english: Flashcards are compact, non-projected graphic aids specifically engineered for active retrieval practice, spaced repetition, and cognitive fluency drills. An effective flashcard presents a single, uncluttered stimulus (a vocabulary word, mathematical fact, historical date, chemical symbol, or question prompt) on one side and its corresponding response on the reverse. When flashed briefly and rapidly before students, they stimulate immediate cognitive retrieval, reinforce neural pathways, and build automaticity (the ability to perform lower-level cognitive operations effortlessly, freeing up working memory for higher-order reasoning). Dense text, mandatory projection, or high-stakes testing run counter to the fundamental design and purpose of flashcards.
questions.explanation_hindi: फ्लैशकार्ड (Flashcards) एक गैर-प्रक्षेपित (non-projected) पारंपरिक दृश्य शिक्षण सामग्री है, जिसका उपयोग मुख्य रूप से अभ्यास एवं पुनरावृत्ति (drill and practice) तथा सक्रिय स्मृति स्मरण (active retrieval) के लिए किया जाता है। एक प्रभावी फ्लैशकार्ड संक्षिप्त, स्पष्ट और बिंदुवार होता है, जिसमें एक तरफ कोई शब्द, सूत्र, संकेत या प्रश्न और दूसरी तरफ उसका उत्तर या अर्थ लिखा होता है। जब शिक्षक इन्हें विद्यार्थियों के समक्ष त्वरित गति से प्रदर्शित (flash) करता है, तो यह छात्रों के मस्तिष्क में तीव्र अवधारणात्मक जुड़ाव, त्वरित पुनर्स्मरण (quick recall) और स्वतःस्फूर्तता (automaticity) का विकास करता है। इससे कार्यकारी स्मृति (working memory) पर भार कम होता है और बुनियादी तथ्य सुदृढ़ होते हैं। यह शब्दावली, गणितीय संक्रियाओं, रासायनिक प्रतीकों आदि को सीखने के लिए अत्यंत उपयोगी है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Flashing them rapidly encourages quick recall and automaticity

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Flashcards operate effectively as drill-and-practice visual tools through rapid, focused presentation. Displaying flashcards quickly encourages mental automaticity, strengthens memory retrieval pathways, and builds rapid recall of key facts, vocabulary, or mathematical concepts without cognitive clutter.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the utilization of instructional aids in inclusive educational frameworks:
I. They offer multiple means of representation in accordance with Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles.
II. They completely eliminate the pedagogical requirement for Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).
III. They can inadvertently create accessibility barriers for students with disabilities if not universally designed.

II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and III are correct, while Statement II is fundamentally incorrect. In inclusive pedagogy, instructional aids operationalize the principles of Universal Design for Learning (UDL), particularly by providing 'multiple means of representation' (Statement I) through visual, tactile, and auditory modalities to accommodate children with diverse sensory, cognitive, and linguistic needs. Furthermore, if instructional aids are poorly chosen or lack accessibility features (such as videos without closed captions for deaf students, or visual charts without tactile alternatives for visually impaired students), they inadvertently erect formidable learning barriers (Statement III). Statement II is false because instructional aids support and enrich classroom inclusion, but they can never eliminate the statutory and pedagogical requirement for Individualized Education Programs (IEPs), which are tailored educational blueprints mandated by law for learners with disabilities.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और III सही हैं, जबकि कथन II सर्वथा गलत है। समावेशी शिक्षाशास्त्र में शिक्षण सहायक सामग्रियां 'सीखने के सार्वभौमिक अभिकल्पन' (UDL) के सिद्धांतों को लागू करती हैं, विशेष रूप से विभिन्न दृश्य, श्रव्य और स्पर्शनीय माध्यमों से 'प्रस्तुतीकरण के बहुविध साधन' (कथन I) प्रदान करके। इसके अतिरिक्त, यदि सहायक सामग्रियों को सार्वभौमिक सुगमता (Universal Design) के सिद्धांतों पर तैयार न किया जाए (उदाहरण के लिए बिना सबटाइटल्स वाले वीडियो या बिना स्पर्श-उभार वाले चार्ट), तो वे दिव्यांग शिक्षार्थियों के लिए नई बाधाएं उत्पन्न कर सकती हैं (कथन III)। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि सहायक सामग्रियां कभी भी 'वैयक्तिकृत शैक्षिक कार्यक्रम' (IEP) का स्थान नहीं ले सकतीं; IEP प्रत्येक विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चे की विशिष्ट शक्तियों और सीमाओं के आधार पर तैयार की जाने वाली कानूनी और शैक्षणिक रूप से अनिवार्य कार्ययोजना है।

questions.question_english: As a school principal, you deal with a teacher who strictly refuses to use the newly installed SMART board, citing personal comfort with the traditional chalkboard. What is the most constructive educational leadership approach?
options_english: Compel the teacher immediately by linking smartboard usage directly to annual appraisal scores
Pair the teacher with an empathetic peer mentor for incremental, low-pressure collaborative training
Completely remove the traditional chalkboard from the room to force technology compliance
Ignore the instructional issue entirely in order to avoid administrative workplace conflict
questions.explanation_english: Transformational educational leadership emphasizes empathy, capacity building, and collaborative change management over coercive authoritarian tactics. Resistance to educational technology often stems from technophobia, fear of embarrassment in front of students, lack of technical self-efficacy, or perceived lack of relevance. Punitive measures such as threatening performance appraisals (Option A) or forcibly confiscating traditional chalkboards (Option C) generate defensiveness, resentment, and alienation. Passive avoidance (Option D) abdicates leadership responsibility and lets expensive resources languish. The most constructive approach is pairing the hesitant teacher with an enthusiastic, supportive peer mentor. This facilitates low-stakes, collegial co-planning, scaffolded practice, and gradual comfort, allowing the teacher to blend the strengths of traditional chalkboard instruction with interactive smartboard tools at an achievable pace.
questions.explanation_hindi: रूपांतरणकारी शैक्षिक नेतृत्व (Transformational Leadership) में किसी भी नवाचार को बलपूर्वक लागू करने के बजाय शिक्षकों की चिंताओं को समझकर उनका संवर्धन किया जाता है। स्मार्ट बोर्ड का उपयोग न करने के पीछे अक्सर तकनीक का भय, बच्चों के सामने झिझक या उपकरण के संचालन में अकुशलता होती है। वार्षिक मूल्यांकन में अंक काटने की धमकी देना (विकल्प A) या कमरे से जबरन चॉकबोर्ड हटवा देना (विकल्प C) एक दमनकारी प्रशासनिक नीति है जो शिक्षक के स्वाभिमान को आहत करती है और विरोध को बढ़ाती है। समस्या की अनदेखी करना (विकल्प D) कर्तव्य से विमुख होना है। सर्वाधिक रचनात्मक दृष्टिकोण यह है कि उस शिक्षक को एक कुशल व सहयोगी साथी शिक्षक (Peer Mentor) के साथ जोड़ा जाए जो मित्रवत और तनावमुक्त परिवेश में धीरे-धीरे उन्हें स्मार्ट बोर्ड की सरल तकनीकों का अभ्यास कराए। इससे शिक्षक का आत्मविश्वास बढ़ेगा और वे स्वेच्छा से तकनीक अपनाएंगे। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प B है।

questions.question_english: When selecting or designing an instructional aid, the principle of 'Simplicity' dictates that:
options_english: The aid should be completely simplistic to the actual point of being scientifically inaccurate
The aid should avoid clutter so learners focus on the core concept
The aid should strictly and exclusively be utilized for primary school level students
The aid should be designed such that it requires absolutely zero prior teacher preparation
questions.explanation_english: In instructional design and pedagogical media selection, the 'Principle of Simplicity' emphasizes that teaching aids (such as charts, diagrams, slides, and physical models) must be clean, unencumbered by irrelevant ornamentation, and focused sharply on targeted learning objectives. Cognitive Load Theory (Sweller) posits that learners possess limited working memory capacity. When an instructional aid is overcrowded with extraneous visual elements, excessive text, decorative clip-art, or irrelevant details (extraneous cognitive load), the learner's attention is diverted away from the salient pedagogical concept. Simplicity ensures clarity, readability, and immediate conceptual grasp without oversimplifying the fundamental scientific or academic accuracy of the subject matter.
questions.explanation_hindi: अनुदेशात्मक प्रारूप और शिक्षण सहायक सामग्री के चयन में 'सरलता का सिद्धांत' (Principle of Simplicity) यह निर्देशित करता है कि सहायक सामग्री को अनावश्यक सजावट, अत्यधिक पाठ्य सामग्री तथा विचलित करने वाले तत्वों से मुक्त और सुस्पष्ट होना चाहिए। संज्ञानात्मक भार सिद्धांत (Cognitive Load Theory) के अनुसार, शिक्षार्थी की कार्यकारी स्मृति (working memory) सीमित होती है। यदि कोई चार्ट, मॉडल या स्लाइड अनावश्यक जानकारी और अव्यवस्था (clutter) से भरी होगी, तो शिक्षार्थी का ध्यान मुख्य शिक्षण संकल्पना से भटक जाएगा। सरलता का अर्थ वैज्ञानिक सटीकता से समझौता करना नहीं है, बल्कि शिक्षण सामग्री को इतना स्पष्ट और केंद्रित बनाना है कि छात्र मुख्य विषय-वस्तु को बिना किसी मानसिक भटकाव के सहजता से ग्रहण कर सकें।

The principle of simplicity in instructional design dictates that teaching aids should be clear, uncluttered, and focused on core learning concepts. Removing extraneous visual details and non-essential information prevents cognitive overload and directs student attention toward targeted learning outcomes.

questions.question_english: As a school principal, you observe that tracking student assignments via email during a prolonged school closure is chaotic and inefficient. What is the most effective systemic solution to address this challenge?

Completely discontinue all homework assignments across all subjects and grade levels permanently

questions.explanation_english: A Learning Management System (LMS) such as Google Classroom, Moodle, or Canvas provides a unified, structured, and secure digital platform for institutional teaching-learning processes. During extended school closures or remote learning scenarios, handling submissions through email often results in missed attachments, lack of central tracking, data privacy risks, and teacher burnout. An LMS centralizes the entire academic workflow: teachers can post assignments with rubrics and deadlines, students can submit work digitally, and teachers can evaluate, grade, provide constructive feedback, and archive records systematically. Collecting physical copies poses safety and logistical barriers; discontinuing assignments undermines academic continuity; and using unmoderated public social media violates student privacy, child online safety norms, and institutional accountability.

questions.question_english: Which of the following factors contributes most significantly to the digital divide in modern school education?

questions.explanation_english: Socio-economic status (SES) is widely recognized by educational researchers as the primary structural driver of the digital divide. questions.question_english: During an emergency school closure or pandemic situation, a school principal must ensure continuous curriculum delivery to learners who lack internet connectivity but have access to television sets. Which component of the Government of India's PM eVIDYA initiative is most directly suited for this purpose?
options_english: National Test Abhyas mobile application
Swayam Prabha DTH television channels
Synchronous interactive webinars via Zoom or Google Meet
Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) on the SWAYAM broadband portal
questions.explanation_english: Under the PM eVIDYA initiative—launched as part of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan in May 2020—a comprehensive multi-modal educational architecture was instituted to bridge the digital divide during school disruptions. The 'One Class, One TV Channel' vertical utilizes the Swayam Prabha Direct-to-Home (DTH) satellite television network (transponders on GSAT-15) to broadcast high-quality, curriculum-aligned educational content 24x7 for Classes 1 to 12. questions.explanation_english: Cognitive psychology research (rooted in Ebbinghaus's Forgetting Curve and the Testing Effect) demonstrates that active recall combined with spaced repetition is the most effective pedagogical technique for mastering factual knowledge, terminology, formulas, and definitions. Mobile applications utilizing spaced-repetition algorithms (such as Anki or Quizlet) automatically schedule the review of specific facts at expanding time intervals—testing the learner right when an item is about to be forgotten. Because mobile devices are portable and suited for frequent, short micro-learning sessions, spaced-repetition flashcard apps maximize long-term factual retention. In contrast, 3-hour continuous mobile videos (Option A) overwhelm working memory; typing massive essays on smartphones (Option C) causes cognitive and ergonomic friction; and aimless video conferences (Option D) lack pedagogical efficacy.

Assertion (A): Mobile learning (M-learning) represents a fundamental paradigm shift from tethered desktop computing to ubiquitous, anytime-anywhere educational access.

questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) provides the accurate explanation of (A). Traditional Computer-Assisted Instruction (CAI) was historically 'tethered' because computing resources were confined to stationary desktop machines located inside dedicated computer laboratories. Learners were constrained to specific physical spaces and fixed timetable slots. Mobile learning (M-learning) dismantles these constraints by utilizing compact, wirelessly networked handheld devices (smartphones, tablets, e-readers). As Reason (R) correctly explains, this portability enables ubiquitous, situated, and just-in-time learning across diverse real-world contexts (e.g., during field observations, home inquiry, or commutes). Thus, Reason (R) explains why M-learning constitutes a true paradigm shift.

questions.question_english: As a head of institution, planning for ICT integration requires consideration of ‘TPACK’. What does TPACK stand for?

questions.explanation_english: TPACK stands for Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge. Developed by Punya Mishra and Matthew J. Koehler (2006) as an extension of Lee Shulman’s Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK) framework, TPACK conceptualizes the essential interplay of three core domains of teacher expertise: Content Knowledge (CK - what is taught), Pedagogical Knowledge (PK - how it is taught), and Technological Knowledge (TK - digital tools utilized). Effective ICT integration occurs at the sweet spot where technology meaningfully facilitates specific pedagogy to convey particular subject content.
questions.explanation_hindi: TPACK का पूर्ण रूप 'Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge' (तकनीकी शैक्षणिक विषय-वस्तु ज्ञान) है। यह फ्रेमवर्क वर्ष 2006 में पुन्या मिश्रा और मैथ्यू जे. कोहलर द्वारा ली शुलमैन के 'पीसीके' (PCK) मॉडल पर आधारित करके विकसित किया गया था। इस मॉडल के अनुसार, एक प्रभावी शिक्षक को तीन प्रमुख ज्ञान क्षेत्रों का समन्वित ज्ञान होना चाहिए: विषय-वस्तु ज्ञान (Content Knowledge - CK), शिक्षणशास्त्रीय ज्ञान (Pedagogical Knowledge - PK), और तकनीकी ज्ञान (Technological Knowledge - TK)। जब ये तीनों आपस में मिलते हैं, तो उसे TPACK कहा जाता है, जो यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि तकनीक का प्रयोग विषय-वस्तु को सरल और ग्राह्य बनाने के लिए किया जाए।

questions.question_english: The PM eVIDYA program aims to achieve 'equity' in education primarily by:
options_english: Providing content across multiple mediums (TV, Radio, Web) tailored to access
Strictly forcing all enrolled students to purchase the exact same expensive model of smartphone
Completely stopping formal education operations for students lacking personal digital access
Entirely eliminating all regional vernacular languages from state digital instructional content
questions.explanation_english: The 'PM eVIDYA' initiative was launched under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan in May 2020 by the Ministry of Education to provide multi-modal access to education and mitigate the digital divide. Educational equity requires that learning opportunities reach every child regardless of socio-economic status, geographical remoteness, or lack of high-speed broadband. PM eVIDYA achieves this by instituting a coherent multi-tiered delivery architecture: 'One Class, One TV Channel' (under SWAYAM Prabha DTH, expanding from 12 to 200 channels to serve grades 1 to 12 in regional languages), extensive community radio broadcasts and podcasts (such as Shiksha Vani), dedicated DAISY and sign language content for children with special needs (Divyang learners), and the DIKSHA web portal for internet-connected learners. This multi-medium synergy ensures that students without smartphones or computers can still access curricular instruction through basic television sets or radios.
questions.explanation_hindi: 'पीएम ई-विद्या' (PM eVIDYA) भारत सरकार के शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा आत्मनिर्भर भारत अभियान के अंतर्गत शुरू की गई एक व्यापक पहल है, जिसका मुख्य उद्देश्य शिक्षा में समता और समावेशिता (equity and inclusion) सुनिश्चित करना है। यह कार्यक्रम इस वास्तविकता को पहचानता है कि देश के सभी बच्चों के पास उच्च गति वाला इंटरनेट या स्मार्टफोन उपलब्ध नहीं है। अतः डिजिटल विभाजन को पाटने के लिए पीएम ई-विद्या एक 'बहु-माध्यमी रणनीति' (multi-modal approach) अपनाता है। इसके अंतर्गत 'एक कक्षा, एक टीवी चैनल' (स्वयं प्रभा डीटीएच टीवी), रेडियो प्रसारण, कम्युनिटी रेडियो, 'शिक्षा वाणी' पॉडकास्ट तथा इंटरनेट-सक्षम छात्रों के लिए 'दीक्षा' (DIKSHA) पोर्टल के माध्यम से कक्षा 1 से 12 तक की पाठ्य सामग्री उपलब्ध कराई जाती है। इससे दूरदराज के और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर छात्र भी टीवी या रेडियो के जरिए अपनी पढ़ाई जारी रख सकते हैं।

questions.question_english: Under national digital education initiatives, the development of Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) for school education (Grades 9 to 12) is primarily coordinated by which two established educational bodies?
options_english: UGC and AICTE
NCERT and NIOS
CBSE and ICSE
NTA and IGNOU
questions.explanation_english: Under the Government of India's SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds) framework, nine National Coordinators were designated to ensure high-quality MOOC content across different educational sectors. For the School Education sector (Grades 9 to 12), the designated National Coordinators are: (1) NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training) for regular school curriculum courses, and (2) NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) for open and distance school education. In contrast, AICTE coordinates self-paced and international courses; UGC coordinates non-technical post-graduation education; CEC coordinates non-technical under-graduation; NPTEL coordinates engineering; IGNOU coordinates certificate and diploma courses for out-of-school students; IIM Bangalore coordinates management; and NITTTR coordinates teacher training. Therefore, NCERT and NIOS are the designated bodies for school education MOOCs.
questions.explanation_hindi: भारत सरकार के शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा संचालित 'स्वयं' (SWAYAM) प्लेटफॉर्म पर विभिन्न स्तरों के पाठ्यक्रम (MOOCs) तैयार करने के लिए नौ 'राष्ट्रीय समन्वयक' (National Coordinators) नियुक्त किए गए हैं। स्कूली शिक्षा (कक्षा 9 से 12) के लिए पाठ्यक्रम विकसित करने और उनका संचालन करने की जिम्मेदारी राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान और प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT) तथा राष्ट्रीय मुक्त विद्यालयी शिक्षा संस्थान (NIOS) को सौंपी गई है। NCERT नियमित स्कूली पाठ्यचर्या हेतु सामग्री तैयार करता है तथा NIOS मुक्त स्कूली शिक्षा हेतु ऑनलाइन पाठ्यक्रम संचालित करता है। अन्य विकल्पों में: यूजीसी (UGC) विश्वविद्यालयी गैर-तकनीकी स्नातकोत्तर शिक्षा के लिए, एआईसीटीई (AICTE) तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए, और इग्नू (IGNOU) दूरस्थ डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए जिम्मेदार है। अतः स्कूली शिक्षा के लिए सही उत्तर विकल्प B (NCERT और NIOS) है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) NCERT and NIOS
